matches.analysis: Cagliari have conceded just once in their last two (a narrow 0-1 to Inter at home, plus a 1-0 win away at Parma) — genuinely tight defensively. Lecce were taken apart 0-4 by Roma last time out. Model rates Cagliari 47% at home to Lecce's 23%, a clear form-and-defence edge rather than a reputation bet.

FEATURED MATCH. Estoril sit 17th with one point from four games (two scored, seven conceded) and are winless at home in seven straight. Arouca sit 3rd with nine points from four — three wins, seven scored, three conceded across their last five. This is the sharpest form gap on the card, and it's a team playing well, not a big name coasting on reputation (the exact opposite of yesterday's Frankfurt mistake). Note: this fixture also has a BTTS history (4-3 and 3-2 in recent meetings) — if the win price isn't there on the exchange, BTTS Yes is the fallback, not a stacked add-on.

Getafe are 1W-2L in their last three with one goal scored across all of them — no attacking case for backing them. Model has this close to a genuine three-way split (37/29/33). No edge either side. Pass.

Neither side is in good form, but the gap in defensive solidity is real: Elche have shipped eight goals in their last three matches (0-5 to Barcelona among them), while Real Sociedad's four-game run (L-L-W-D) at least included a clean-ish sheet spell. Model gives the visitors 43% to the hosts' 30%. Modest conviction — stake held at standard $15, not bumped up.

Udinese are unbeaten in two (W3-2, D1-1) and scoring freely; Lazio's underlying form doesn't clearly outweigh that. Model has it at 33.5% / 30.9% / 35.6% — a genuine coin flip. No one-sentence case for either side. Pass.
